request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 be verified on 1 June 2027?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P1Y", "text": "The IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane (position 13, manufactured January 2017, per the IGEA technical sheet Allegato A, table A2) must be verified annually. Under Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/08, lines 12 and 15, lifting equipment over 200 kg used in the extractive sector is verified annually, and the fixed-equipment line applies to units more than 10 years old, which this crane is by 1 June 2027.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 15", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifica annuale"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 12", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo | Verifica annuale"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6, ALLEGATO A, Tabella A2", "quote": "GRU A PONTE 2017- 13 IGEA -PRIM 5t 5000 2017 gen-17 SCORREVOLE 200086/CA"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3, sezione 2.2", "quote": "Qtà COMUNE Area mineraria Monteponi 19 Iglesias Campo Pisano Masua - Acquaresi 2 Gadoni Miniera Funtana Raminosa 2 Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1 Furtei Miniera Furtei"}]}
